test_torch_dtype_resolver: test the _torch_dtype_resolver function resolves float32, float16, bfloat16, and float64 strings to torch dtypes
test_fsdp_param_strategy_resolver: test the _fsdp_param_strategy_resolver function resolves DEFAULT strategy string to FSDPParamAssignmentStrategy enum
test_weight_decay_type_resolver: test the _weight_decay_type_resolver function resolves DECOUPLED and L2 strings to WeightDecayType enum
test_register_resolvers: test the register_resolvers function registers torch_dtype, fsdp_param_strategy, and weight_decay_type resolvers in OmegaConf
test_resolver_error_handling: test that _torch_dtype_resolver, _fsdp_param_strategy_resolver, and _weight_decay_type_resolver raise ValueError on invalid input
